hab: Revived in Bureau labs; once, the first railway cutting
bio: A snake of iron rail with a smokestack and a top hat, dug out of the cutting where the first line was laid. Revived, it lays track wherever it slithers and charges a fare to anyone who crosses it.
note: The line goes where it says. So do you.
